figures.caption: Figure 32. Illustrative BDA workflow linking design variables, atomistic calculations, particle and interface models, electrode homogenization, and cell- level predictions. Each arrow identifies the information passed to the next stage. Bottom-up transfer supplies constitutive relations; state feedback updates their state-dependent inputs; experimental feedback informs parameter calibration and the next design. Model branches are selected according to the relevant chemistry. The diagram represents a proposed workflow and does not imply that every coupling has already been implemented or experimentally validated in one platform.
